field_evidence.building_semantics: The feature is defined as a built entity that includes a roof.
field_evidence.geometry: The geometry attribute is a polygon representing the generalised building.
field_evidence.parcel_semantics: The source feature type is Building, not a cadastral/title/parcel feature; no parcel identifier or parcel geometry field is defined.
field_evidence.open_data: OS OpenMap – Local is an OS OpenData product; OS states that OS OpenData uses the Open Government Licence.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap–Local Building feature defines a real polygon geometry for a built entity, but explicitly as a generalised building geometry rather than a parcel/title extent. Therefore it can support BUILDING_PRESENT context but cannot be promoted to canonical parcel geometry or bbox. Local OpenCode must bind a target-specific canonical parcel geometry/title context; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap–Local Building feature is a materially different source family from the repeated HM Land Registry title/INSPIRE access paths. It supplies polygon semantics for a generalised building, not a land parcel or title extent. Under the fixed Height Difference contract, a building footprint cannot be substituted for canonical parcel geometry. No target-specific canonical parcel binding exists in the verified lineage, so accepted/materialized/direct parcel counts remain zero and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
